description: This file defines a React functional component 'BudgetPanel' for managing budgets in a UI, including CRUD operations, displaying a list of budgets, and providing usage instructions with code snippets.

methods.name: handleEditCall
methods.description: Prepares and shows the modal for editing a selected budget.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Sets the selected budget and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Executes budget deletion using API call, manages notifications, and refreshes the budget list.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Closes the delete modal without deleting.

methods.name: handleUpdateCall
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of budgets.
